description: SpecReview plan-mode gate: every ExitPlanMode opens the plan in SpecReview and blocks until the reviewer submits a review, then allows the plan (Approve) or denies it with the feedback (Request changes / Comment). It fails open (prints nothing, exits 0) on any error or when Claude Code cancels it. Kept apart from hooks.json so that `specreview install claude --with-hooks` does not turn on a blocking gate.
